bagPolicy.summary: Dazzle hasn't published bag policy details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

parking.summary: Park in the Denver Performing Arts Complex garage, with entrances on Arapahoe Street and 13th Street. The garage takes electronic payment only, and valet is available for up to 4 hours. The spots in front of Dazzle are loading and unloading only after 5 PM.
parking.quote: The DPAC parking garage has entrances on Arapahoe Street and 13th Street.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Dazzle. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Dazzle has full food and drink service, and dining is encouraged. Every show has a two-item food or drink minimum per person, or one item for guests under 19. Use the QR code on your table to order.
concessions.quote: Yes, there is a minimum two-item food or beverage purchase at all performances

accessibility.summary: Dazzle hasn't published accessibility details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

reEntry.summary: Dazzle hasn't published re-entry details on its official site. Check your event page or contact the venue before you go.

ticketPickup.summary: Buy tickets only from Dazzle, since tickets bought through resellers aren't accepted, and Dazzle doesn't sell tickets over the phone. Most shows are all ages until 11 PM. After 11 PM the club is 21 and up only under Colorado liquor law.
ticketPickup.quote: After 11:00PM we are 21 and up only, in accordance with Colorado Liquor Law.

gates.summary: For evening ticketed shows, seating begins one hour before the first performance. Doors for a later show open 30 minutes before it starts, and daytime events also open 30 minutes early. Most shows have assigned seats that you pick when you buy, so arrive early to allow time for parking.
gates.quote: Seating for evening ticketed performances begins one hour prior to the first performance.
